weather: Frost and ice on the passes in the mornings. No heavy snow forecast.

routes.name: Otmek tunnel
routes.label: Open
routes.note: Open all year. Dangerous goods only from 22:00 to 05:00. The old pass road above the tunnel: closed for the season.

routes.name: Fergana Gateway (Ala-Bel pass)
routes.label: Ice: drive with care
routes.note: Low −10°C. Cross after 10:00 if you can.

routes.name: Kök-Bel road
routes.label: Open
routes.note: Low −5°C. About 28 km cross tribal pasture: give way to herds.

routes.name: Qara-Chik crossing
routes.road: Kara-Buura valley, 15 km south of Kyzyl-Adyr
routes.label: Open
routes.note: Open to travellers with an ISEZ exit registration and an invitation from the clan council. The pass road beyond it to the Chatkal valley: ice: drive with care.
